questions.question: Which gate is known as a universal gate?
questions.explanation: NAND can implement all other basic logic gates.

questions.question: How many minterms are possible for a Boolean function with 3 variables?
questions.explanation: A function with 3 variables has 2^3 = 8 possible minterms.

questions.question: Which flip-flop toggles its state when both inputs are high?
questions.explanation: JK flip-flop toggles when J = K = 1.
